text: APPROVE: The extracted helpers keep the lexing logic and the comment/code blanking identical to the original (including the `is '/' or '*'` precedence and the `Math.Min` clamp), and each method's cognitive complexity is now well under 15 (Lex is about 8, the highest helper, `StringEnd`, about 13). I couldn't build the project here, so I assumed the new helper names don't collide with existing members of this large partial class.
